summary: Iteration 8 fully verified. Backend (13/13 pytest pass): POST /api/login with cpf5+phone4 -> 11111/1111 João (200, is_admin=false, is_staff=false), 00000/0000 Admin (is_admin=true), 55555/0055 Staff (is_staff=true); 11111/9999 -> 404; missing/short phone -> 400; short cpf -> 400. PATCH /api/requests/{id}/reopen flips status from 'concluida' back to 'agendada' and clears returned_at (verified via GET). Regression: /slots, /tides (sp01), GET /users still excludes admin+staff, POST/DELETE /users/{cpf}/boats add+remove with draft/length OK. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) Login form has cpf-input maxlen5 + phone-input maxlen4; wrong phone -> login-error banner. (2) Client 11111/1111 redirects to /menu (menu-user-name='Olá, João'), with 4 buttons menu-descida-subida / menu-conveniencia / menu-autorizar / menu-emergencia. The 3 placeholders load conveniencia-screen/autorizar-screen/emergencia-screen with a working back that returns to /menu. (3) menu-descida-subida opens /home (home-user-name visible), cards read exactly 'Alterar Descida'/'Alterar Subida' (NO 'Confirmar' word); home-back returns to /menu. (4) Client Alterar Subida: active row shows ONLY cancel-request-{id} — the previous 'Confirmar retorno' button is GONE (verified by testID absence AND full-body text scan for 'Confirmar retorno' -> not found). Concluded rows show only the 'Retorno confirmado às HH:MM' timestamp with no action buttons. (5) Staff panel: staff-confirm-{id} on agendada; after tap, row transitions to Concluída and shows two correction buttons staff-reopen-{id} + staff-cancel-{id}; reopen restores status='agendada' & returned_at=null (verified via GET /api/requests/{id}); cancel sets status='cancelada' (verified via GET). (6) Admin 00000/0000 redirects to /admin. (7) Boat name 'Netuno' NOT shown under João's name on the menu header. All 6 iteration-8 changes + regression pass.

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — still present on login/other screens (index.tsx logoBadge & similar). Non-blocking on native; only web console warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:132-143

action_items: Optional/cosmetic: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN 0.75+ deprecation console warnings on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:227-239 login combines cpf-prefix regex ($regex ^prefix) + phone last-4 match on the app side; safe because both inputs are digit-normalized before use.
server.py:391-401 reopen_request sets returned_at=None (not deleting the field) — good, keeps schema stable; RequestOut.returned_at is Optional[str] so JSON returns null.
app/alterar.tsx:60-69 client cancel is optimistic-then-persist with load() rollback on failure — good pattern.
app/alterar.tsx has NO doConfirm / confirm-return button — matches spec (only cancel-request-{id} remains).
app/staff.tsx:59-77 reopen + cancel handlers mirror the optimistic pattern; UI branches by status (agendada -> confirm, concluida -> reopen+cancel, cancelada -> no buttons).
app/menu.tsx correctly hides boat name; renders 4 Pressables with distinct testIDs and colors; useFocusEffect reloads user from AsyncStorage on return.
app/home.tsx:96-98 home-back navigates via router.back() to /menu — verified working.
conveniencia/autorizar/emergencia are thin wrappers around ComingSoon which exposes back navigation testID.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login redirects for client/admin/staff, wrong-phone error, menu 4 buttons + 3 placeholder screens with back, home cards renamed no-Confirmar + home-back, client alterar has only Cancelar (no Confirmar retorno), staff confirm->reopen/cancel flow verified via API, boat name not shown under user name)

Use time '17:30' subida for unlimited-slot seeding to avoid capacity 409s.
